direct_answer: PDS45 preserves the pinned revision and passes document conditionals, query pagination bounds, and request-ID parity on observed errors. It still fails the complete API contract: POST returns 404 instead of 405, 406 is internal_error, invalid perspective silently becomes published, CLI history ignores limit, and only three of six identity domains are exposed. Safe read-only probes could not produce server 422, 500, or timeout envelopes.

observations.discovery_schema: partial: capabilities/OpenAPI/schema get/list succeed; OpenAPI omits required error matrix and makes request_id optional
observations.identity_domains: 3/6 fields and 2/6 distinct values; release, projection, and cycle missing; ETag equals revision
observations.conditionals: 4/4: exact and wildcard 304 empty; stale and absent 200 current
observations.pagination_perspective: query pagination and clamping pass; invalid perspective silently published; history limit 1 returns all 10

inferences: Invalid perspective follows anonymous published pinning plus parser fallback.
History limit fails at the manifest/CLI forwarding seam because doc.history is not declared paginated.
406 internal_error follows generic non-404 ErrorJSON mapping.
repair_seams: Return typed 405 and negotiation-specific 406 with request-ID parity.
Mark and forward history pagination end to end.
Deploy six distinct identity domains rather than isolated candidate fields.
Use a disposable environment for deterministic 422, 500, and server-timeout receipts.
Require request_id and complete endpoint error responses in OpenAPI.
